title: Approximate
summary: APPROX'IMATE, adjective [Latin ad and proximus, next. See approach.] Nearest to; next; near to. [This word is superseded by proximate.] APPROX'IMATE, verb transitive To carry or advance near; to cause

inlines.v: APPROX'IMATE, adjective [Latin ad and proximus, next. See approach.] Nearest to; next; near to. [This word is superseded by proximate.] APPROX'IMATE, verb transitive To carry or advance near; to cause to approach. To approximate the inequality of riches to the level of nature. APPROX'IMATE, verb intransitive To come near; to approach.
